name: NLPCC2018
evaluation_notes: Check whether F0.5 is word-level or character-level. The survey notes that NLPCC2018 test data include a word-segmented view.
notes: Early large-scale CGEC benchmark built from Lang-8 learner data.
source: CGEC survey Sections 2.2 and Table 2, pages 10-11 and 23

name: MuCGEC
evaluation_notes: Closely connected to ChERRANT, a character-based span-level annotation/evaluation toolkit.
notes: Evaluation-oriented multi-reference dataset drawn from several learner-data sources.
source: CGEC survey Sections 2.3 and Table 2, pages 11-12 and 23

name: YACLC
evaluation_notes: Keep acceptability and correction dimensions separate when adding results.

name: FlaCGEC
domain: HSK reading corpus and proficiency-standards grammar examples
error_label_explicitness: explicit grammar points and edit types
evaluation_notes: Synthetic construction and grammar-point labels should be visible when comparing with natural-error datasets.
notes: Useful for grammar-point coverage, but not directly comparable to naturally occurring corpora.

name: FCGEC
domain: public-school Chinese exams; supplemental error-free news sentences
evaluation_notes: Often reported as span-level F0.5 with ChERRANT in recent papers.
notes: Native-speaker correction dataset with explicit operations and categories.
source: CGEC survey Sections 2.6 and Table 2, pages 15-16 and 23

name: CCTC
domain: news, blogs, and popular science articles
evaluation_notes: Document context may matter for some errors, so sentence-only comparisons should be marked.
notes: Complements sentence-level benchmarks with document-level native writing.
source: CGEC survey Sections 2.7 and Table 2, pages 16-17 and 23

name: NaCGEC
evaluation_notes: Sentence-level error categories are more explicit than plain sentence pairs, but errors are not localized as spans.
source: CGEC survey Section 2.8 and Table 2, pages 17-18 and 23

name: NaSGEC
domain: social media, undergraduate theses, and exams
error_label_explicitness: no primary span labels; edit types post-extracted
evaluation_notes: The paper extracts span-level edits with MuCGEC/ChERRANT for analysis.
source: CGEC survey Section 2.9 and Table 2, pages 18-19 and 23

name: CEFE
error_label_explicitness: explicit in identification tracks; implicit in rewriting
evaluation_notes: Keep rewriting and error-identification tracks separate.
notes: Essay fluency evaluation task with correction and identification views.
source: CGEC survey Section 2.10 and Table 2, pages 19-23
